rows: Whether a transiting planet's atmosphere is measurable
Works best for large/close planets; retrieval is inverse modeling with cloud/haze degeneracies.
Whether a hot planet's dayside chemistry is accessible
Strong for hot planets, not Earth analog biosignatures.
Best for hot Jupiters and strongly irradiated planets.
Whether full-disk reflected light is possible
JWST is marginal; Earth analogs need future coronagraph/starshade-class missions.
Whether narrow molecular lines can be separated
O2/CO2/H2O at very high resolution needs ELT-class instruments, not JWST.
